title: Chapter 91 The First Wave Of Attack
content:
Chapter 91 The First Wave Of Attack

After using 120 wall defense charms.

At this time, the outer wall was instantly covered by an energy wall.

This milky white, transparent wall is about 10 meters high and 4 meters thick.

It is enough to withstand the jump of wild beasts.

The durability of each square meter is 10,000, and the defense is as high as an astonishing 100 points.

Ordinary beasts can't even break the defense, and there is no way to cause damage.

Moreover, this wall does not affect the actions of the internal personnel. They can still stand on the original wall and attack the outside.

This gave Wang Shuo a great boost in confidence.

At the same time, he thought in his heart that after the war, he must build such a solid wall.

The dense beasts roared and came, and the ground was shaking slightly.

It was like a magnitude 4 earthquake.

Wang Shuo seemed to hear "The enemy has 5 seconds to reach the battlefield, crush them!"

After a few breaths.

The fast-moving wild wolf was the first to reach the edge of the light wall.

It's just that there is a circle of mud pits outside the city wall, which hinders their progress.

Wang Shuo saw these chaotic and orderly wolves, and he inexplicably felt a sense of ritual of a military parade.

[Grassland Gray Wolf]

[Level: Level 6]

[Attack: 37]

[Defense: 8]

[Health: 950]

[Skills: None]

[Evaluation: The most common wild wolf on the grassland, a single one, is slightly stronger than a wild dog, but they are social beasts, usually appear in groups, if you encounter a wolf pack, you have to be careful! ]

After seeing the attributes, Wang Shuo smiled.

This low-level beast can't even break the defense of the city wall.

Several fierce wild wolves tried to step into the mud pit and were directly trapped.

Just like Wang Shuo fell into the swamp at the beginning.

The wild wolf struggled a few times, and then slowly sank.

Not only were the other wild wolves not scared away, but they stepped into the mud pit one after another.

"What hatred, what resentment! Is it necessary to do this?"

However, Wang Shuo admired their courage.

Not long after, the mud pit was filled with wolf corpses.

The wild wolves behind rushed over.

As expected, although these wild wolves bit the milky white light wall desperately, they did not leave even a trace of tooth marks.

Wang Shuo snorted coldly, took out the flame gun directly, jumped onto the outer wall less than one meter wide, and began to attack the wild wolves.

The long spear quickly attacked and pierced into the wolf's back without any hindrance.

A casual shot caused more than 150 points of damage.

With the protection of the light wall, there is no need to worry about safety.

Wang Shuo killed very vigorously.

At this time, Hua Tianxiong also shouted: "Militia team, go up the wall to kill the wolves."

The militia team, dressed in fine armor and armed with various weapons, also joined the battlefield directly.

Seeing that Wang Shuo was not in any danger at all, they were naturally not afraid and rushed to kill the wild wolves.

The reason why they worked so hard was not because of Wang Shuo's few words.

But Wang Shuo promised that according to the number of beasts killed, they would be given a lot of rewards, including skills, equipment, job transfer certificates, etc.

These things were simply the dream of the militia team that did not have a combat profession.

Wang Shuo even took out the golden long axe and showed its attributes to everyone.

Seeing this, everyone's eyes sparkled and drooled.
